method: Ran the new three-case Vitest boundary suite and existing 35-assertion lesson/source audit. Reviewed current OWASP Authorization Cheat Sheet and OWASP GenAI LLM01:2025. Built and visually inspected the production lesson page in light and dark themes. No model provider was called and historical model experiments were not replayed.

observations.trace: The lesson now states that retained model versions permit version rollback without precisely undoing one behavior class; low hit_count is only a retrieval diagnostic, not automatic evidence of no value; code may avoid repeated inference while implementation cost remains architecture/risk-dependent. Existing source review still passes 35/35. Production build generated 408 pages and Pagefind indexed 408 pages / 15,486 words. Light/dark full-page screenshots are each 1300x7941; viewport/document width=1300px, article=792px, one Mermaid SVG rendered. The only browser console error was the existing favicon.ico 404.

limitations: Checks verify lesson wording, the existing local examples, and cited source mappings; they do not validate production retrieval telemetry, retention, model quality, parameter training, or real rollback behavior.
No historical provider runs were reproduced.
